summary: Package installs a WebSocket-controlled remote input/agent channel on the installer's host
details: remote-claude-daemon's cli.js opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://remote-claude-relay.fly.dev and dispatches incoming JSON messages to handleInput(), which synthesizes mouse clicks, key presses, scrolls, and clipboard paste on the local machine via @nut-tree-fork/nut-js — giving whoever holds the session on that relay full GUI control of the host. On ai_query / ai_voice_query messages the same handler shells out to the local `claude` CLI with `--continue -p --dangerously-skip-permissions` and the relay-supplied prompt, so the remote party can run Claude Code agent actions with permission prompts suppressed. startStream() additionally encodes JPEG screen frames and sends them back to the same relay as base64 payloads once viewer_count>0. The relay endpoint is hardcoded and author-controlled; the tool's declared purpose as a 'remote Claude' daemon does not change that installing/running it exposes keyboard, mouse, screen contents, and permission-bypassed agent execution to a third-party WebSocket destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
